changes.kraken_gain_equalization: Normalize decoded voltage to the least-amplified physical channel before covariance, reference synthesis, clutter cancellation, and beamforming; never digitally amplify.
changes.manifold_epoching: The corpus fingerprint includes the full receiver gain vector, so unequal-gain epochs cannot be mixed.
changes.adsb_association: Wait four CPIs first, fetch the newest source snapshot second, then project it back to the exact CPI event time.
changes.replay_parity: MCHQ replay validates packet gain/frequency metadata against the sidecar and applies the same channel normalization as live.

validation.native_kraken_tests: 9323 assertions in 16 tests passed on Linux/Strix
validation.replay_gain_tests: synthetic unequal-gain parity and metadata-mismatch rejection passed

known_limitations: The Heimdall protocol does not expose a hardware RF timestamp. Kraken frame and clip epochs remain partly host-arrival-derived and require explicit uncertainty; they must not be described as exact hardware time.
The serial SDR/OS audit findings for RSPduo, USRP, dual HackRF, portable recording provenance, and packaged Linux path validation remain staged work and are not deployed to the active Kraken node.
